crossRefs.keyword: How old art thou. Heb. How many are the days of the years ofthy life?

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How old are you?”
translations.bsb: “How many years have you lived?” Pharaoh asked.
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old
translations.asv: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How many are the days of the years of thy life?
